scope: Compact aggregation of the v9 integration, foundation, cold-proof, small-comparison, 32K, 128K-pilot, and 128K receipts.

The natural cold-promotion eligibility edge was absent.
The 32K prerequisite was not eligible; no runtime was instantiated.
The 128K pilot was not eligible; no population or ledger was instantiated.

scale_identity.32k: requested only; no process or allocation
scale_identity.128k_pilot: requested only; no process or allocation
scale_identity.128k: requested only; no process or allocation

units.ratios: dimensionless selected divided by named control

formula_checks: selected_over_cpu_kv.decode = selected.tg_tok_s / cpu_kv.tg_tok_s; three paired samples are present
selected_over_all_gpu.decode = selected.tg_tok_s / all_gpu.tg_tok_s; three paired samples are present
accepted_tokens <= proposed_tokens for every recorded small and cold row
cold natural promotion requires attention_samples > 0, a cold candidate, promotion publication, selected_cold_pages_used > 0, and useful H2D bytes; the receipt has none of these
unknown counters and unavailable ratios remain null rather than zero or extrapolated

cold_proof.selection_quality: not measured: no current-Q sample/candidate was published; the diagnostic selected all 16 pages

small_comparison.workload: Original three token-counted prompts; fresh slots; temperature 0; seed 42; thinking off; 128 committed output tokens.

cpu_main_kv.mode: --no-kv-offload; GPU model weights; GPU Turbo4 draft

small_comparison.interpretation: The CPU-main-KV denominator is real and the selected route is faster on committed decode. The all-GPU control is also real; selected decode is approximately equal to it, while selected prefill and TTFT are substantially slower. This is not a dense-equivalent or overall speed win.

cold_proof.recall: cedar; coherent cold-topic answer and append-after-recall passed

foundation_fixture.route: packed for selected typed views; direct only explicit diagnostic fixture
foundation_fixture.packed_event_overhead: 1–3% versus contiguous across measured A/U shapes
foundation_fixture.dominant_measured_event: first append+attention event; includes append metadata/page-table and first-use graph/kernel warmup, not tail H2D

memory.cpu_rss_reason: not captured by the bounded receipt

failure_classification.measurement_failure: The live packed path published no usable current-Q attention sample or catalogue candidate: attention_samples=0, attention_skipped=10, transfer_submitted=0, and h2d_bytes=0. The 32K and 128K gates therefore correctly remained not_run.
failure_classification.runtime_failure: No selected small-request crash, non-finite result, or output-completion failure was recorded. The cold-topic recall and append-after-recall were coherent, but that does not prove cold transfer.
failure_classification.selection_quality: Unmeasured, not failed: the normal candidate set was absent and the A4096/recent512 diagnostic selected all 16 pages, so recall cannot be attributed to attention-ranked cold selection.
latency_dominators: Foundation: first incremental append+attention event 22.969280 ms versus 1.246208–1.299456 ms for later tails.
Cold receipt: 115 graph builds, 0 replays, 115 router refreshes, and 4,896,310 us queue time; this identifies graph/router churn as a measured hot-loop cost.
Small comparison: selected prefill and TTFT are slower than all-GPU, but no per-category small receipt exists, so a finer attribution would be speculation.

ledger_256k_estimate.basis: Measured C5415/H4096 cold receipt and foundation fixed-category receipt; missing categories remain null.

canonical_host_history.basis: Proportional estimate from measured canonical host valid bytes at C_after=5415
canonical_host_history.confidence: low; page metadata and partial final page may change the slope

target_hot_H16384_sensitivity.basis: Linear page-capacity sensitivity only; not a fit or allocation

full_L_draft_gpu.basis: No authoritative draft-context byte counter was present in the selected receipts

all_history_catalogue.formula: llama_context_catalogue_reserve_bytes: sum over full-attention layers of page_count * (2 * F16 KV row + validity/generation/position metadata), aligned
all_history_catalogue.basis: The source formula is known, but model geometry/catalogue_bytes was not present in the selected receipts

packed_workspace.formula: hold measured two-owner A=4096 workspace constant

graph.confidence: conditional; larger full-L graph shape is unmeasured

measured_category_partial_sum.basis: Host estimate plus H4096 target and fixed measured categories
measured_category_partial_sum.confidence: not a total: excludes weights, full-L draft, catalogue, recurrent state, transfer ring, and other admission charges

must_prove_next: A real full-L=262144 GPU draft allocation with target/draft K/V Turbo4, native MTP, and authoritative admission/headroom bytes
Catalogue and graph/scratch bytes at the resolved 256K geometry, with no inferred values standing in for null counters
Natural current-Q catalogue candidate publication followed by authenticated H2D promotion and target attention use before any 256K achievement claim

next_actions.action: Repair the first missing edge: make a completed current-Q attention sample reach the catalogue/policy producer and publish a candidate with its identity tuple.
next_actions.cheapest_discriminating_test: Run the existing focused attention-telemetry tests, then one bounded C>H natural recall request; require attention_samples>0 and a non-sentinel query/catalogue candidate before considering scale.
next_actions.stop_condition: If the natural request still has zero samples, zero candidate publication, or zero H2D, do not launch 32K.

next_actions.action: Check packed-route Q transform/grouping against the selected Turbo4 K/V layout and preserve the full-L GPU native-MTP contract.
next_actions.cheapest_discriminating_test: Use the existing CUDA selected-packed/multi-KV-head attention fixture and compare its output/route metadata with the contiguous typed-view control at A4096/U128.
next_actions.stop_condition: Stop at the first Q/layout or route mismatch; do not revive the superseded direct-kernel performance path.

next_actions.action: After actions 1–2 pass, rerun one natural cold proof and the original-three-prompt comparison; only then reopen the bounded 32K gate and conditionally the 128K pilot.
next_actions.cheapest_discriminating_test: Use the existing incremental recall harness at C>H and inspect candidate_was_cold, promotion_published, selected_cold_pages_used, useful H2D bytes, and committed recall before any scale allocation.
next_actions.stop_condition: Do not claim 32K/128K/256K capability unless the natural cold proof and full-L GPU-Turbo4 ledger are both measured.

deferred_verification: No new live campaign was launched for this aggregation task; 32K and both 128K receipts remain honest not_run findings behind the failed natural-cold gate.
256K remains an estimate/design extension, not a demonstrated runtime result.
CPU RSS, full-L draft bytes at 256K, catalogue bytes at 256K, and larger-context graph/scratch growth are null because the selected receipts did not measure them.

decision.reason: The compact small comparison and full-L GPU Turbo4 native-MTP identity are valid, but natural cold selection/promotion is not proven and the larger campaign was correctly not run.
decision.next_action: Repair current-Q attention-sample/catalogue publication, verify packed Q/layout, then rerun the bounded natural proof before scale.
